import sys, json, time

  ('whitespace-only policy', [{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':' \t\n\r\f'*100000}],
   {'results':[{'events':[{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False],'rows':[[4294967295]]}}]}]}),

   {'results':[{'events':[{'error':'rejected'}]}]}),
  ('unicode whitespace in policy', [{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'}],
   {'results':[{'events':[{'error':'rejected'}]}]}),
  ('nbsp in policy', [{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'}],
   {'results':[{'events':[{'error':'rejected'}]}]}),
  ('32769 semicolons', [{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'*32769}],
   {'results':[{'events':[{'error':'rejected'}]}]}),
